nodes.label: Rolling Save Progress Watchdog
nodes.rationale: Only a newer save_progress_seq renews save_confirm_timeout_sec, preventing repeated status messages from keeping a stalled save alive; the timeout must exceed the slowest uninstrumented durable-write phase.

nodes.label: Maximum Metadata Reconciliation Wait
nodes.rationale: max_save_wait_sec bounds how long the gesture controller waits for metadata reconciliation even when save progress continues, without cancelling the in-flight durable writer transaction.

nodes.label: SAVING Discard Rejection and Failed-Save Recovery
nodes.rationale: DISCARD is rejected during an in-flight durable commit; a failed save transitions to FAILED, where episode-scoped DISCARD becomes available.
nodes.norm_label: saving discard rejection and failed-save recovery

nodes.label: Shutdown Grace and Staging Recovery
nodes.rationale: On shutdown the collector waits for save_shutdown_grace_sec before warning and then continues waiting so the writer cannot outlive the node; external termination leaves staging data for startup recovery.

nodes.label: save_confirm_timeout_sec 120 Seconds
nodes.rationale: The rolling watchdog is configured to exceed the slowest save phase that cannot emit intermediate progress.

nodes.label: max_save_wait_sec 600 Seconds
